definitions.explanation: An appliance that heats water, either a gas water heater installed in a kitchen or bathroom, or an electric kettle-type device.

examples.japanese: {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}が{壊|こわ}れた。
キッチンに{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: We installed a water heater in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}は{安全|あんぜん}のために{早|はや}めに{交換|こうかん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It is better to replace an old water heater early for safety reasons.

notes:
USAGE:
Often refers to a small gas water heater (瞬間湯沸かし器) installed above a kitchen sink, which was common in older Japanese apartments. Can also refer to electric water boilers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}を{交換|こうかん}する (to replace a water heater)
- ガス{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (gas water heater)
- {瞬間|しゅんかん}{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (instant water heater)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給湯器|きゅうとうき}: hot water heater — a more modern/formal term for the same appliance
- ポット: electric pot — an appliance that boils and keeps water warm
